node.title: Re: SSH and expect without module
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my $SSH = system "$ssh_cli $login $ip"; if ($SSH =~ /username/i) {

Sorry, this will not do what you expect. [doc://system] waits until the command finishes, does not capture the command's output and does not allow interactive communication with the subprocess.

I would instead recommend the module [mod://Net::OpenSSH]. Its documentation shows you how to integrate it with other modules such as [mod://Expect]. Since you seem to want to connect to multiple remote machines to execute commands there, you might also take a look at [mod://Net::OpenSSH::Parallel] (I haven't used it myself yet but I've heard good things).

without the possibility to install any module

I recommend you have a look at [id://693828]. If you really, really can't install any modules, you could have a look at my writeup on interacting with external commands [id://1180578|here] and you'd have to study [doc://perlipc], but I would strongly recommend you follow the above advice to use something like [mod://Net::OpenSSH] instead. There was even [id://1184423|a thread] two days ago asking a question similar to yours, in which [salva] mentioned you can install it simply by copying over its lib directory.
